description_en: Retrieves a list of partitions for a data lake table based on filter conditions
description_zh: 调用此API可根据筛选条件获取数据湖表分区列表
kebab_example: aliyun dms list-data-lake-partition-by-filter --catalog-name hive --db-name default --table-name test_table --filter ds_20241201 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDataLakePartitionByFilter

parameters.help_en:
The tenant ID.

Hover over your profile picture in the upper-right corner of the DMS console to obtain the tenant ID. For details, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en: The name of the data catalog
parameters.name: catalog_name

parameters.help_en:
Query conditional expression. Supported operators:

Comparison operators: =, <>, !=, <, <=, >, and >=. For example: \`ds>20240101\`.

Logical operators: AND, OR, and NOT. For example: \`ds LIKE '20240%'\`.

The BETWEEN operator, which specifies a range. For example: \`ds BETWEEN 20240101 AND 20241201\`.

The IN operator, which specifies a set of values. For example: \`ds IN (20240101, 20240102)\`
parameters.help_zh:
查询条件表达式。支持如下运算符：
比较运算符：=、<>、!=、<、<=、>、>=。例如：ds>20240101。
逻辑运算符：AND、OR、NOT。例如：ds LIKE '20240%'。
BETWEEN运算符：用于指定一个范围。例如：ds BETWEEN 20240101 AND 20241201。
IN运算符：用于指定特定的值集合。例如：ds IN (20240101, 20240102)
parameters.name: filter
